sourceText: Clinic outcome comparison: Clinic A and Clinic B compare recovery counts across easy cases and hard cases within all cases during April. Clinic A recovery numerator is 9 count during April among easy cases. Clinic A recovery denominator is 10 count during April among easy cases. Clinic A recovery numerator is 20 count during April among hard cases. Clinic A recovery denominator is 100 count during April among hard cases. Clinic B recovery numerator is 80 count during April among easy cases. Clinic B recovery denominator is 100 count during April among easy cases. Clinic B recovery numerator is 1 count during April among hard cases. Clinic B recovery denominator is 10 count during April among hard cases. Easy cases and hard cases partition all cases for Clinic A and Clinic B during April. Clinic A has higher recovery ratio than Clinic B within every supplied subgroup, but Clinic B has higher recovery ratio than Clinic A within all cases during April. Clinic outcome comparison retains the scope-bound reversal excluding a universal winner.
